name: Parameters.star_ζ
summary: Compare under the injective embedding Φ_1: a root of unity in ℂ has absolute value 1, so its conjugate is its inverse.

steps.claim: Φ_1 : E → ℂ is injective, so it suffices that Φ_1(conj ζ(P, s)) = Φ_1(ζ(P, s)⁻¹).
steps.lean:
@[simp] lemma Parameters.star_ζ : star (P.ζ s) = (P.ζ s)⁻¹ := (Φ 1).injective (by
  simp [Complex.inv_eq_conj, (isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.map_of_injective (Φ _).injective).norm'_eq_one,
    ne])

steps.claim: Φ_1(ζ(P, s)) is a primitive N₁(P, s)-th root of unity in ℂ, so |Φ_1(ζ(P, s))| = 1 and conj(Φ_1(ζ(P, s))) = Φ_1(ζ(P, s))⁻¹; and Φ_1 commutes with conjugation (CM embedding).
